feedback.problem: Find a parametric equation of the plane that passes through the point $B(-2,23,14)$ and is parallel to the lines $r=⟨-3,5,1⟩+s⟨-3,5,4⟩$ and $r=⟨-30,55,25⟩+t⟨4,7,-1⟩.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The direction vectors of the lines are ${v}_{1}=⟨-3,5,4⟩$ and ${v}_{2}=⟨4,7,-1⟩$, respectively. These vectors are parallel to the plane but not to each other.

We also know that the point $B(-2,23,14)$ lies on the plane and its position vector is $b=⟨-2,23,14⟩.$  

So, the corresponding parametric equation of the plane is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =b+s{v}_{1}+t{v}_{2} \\ r & =⟨-2,23,14⟩+s⟨-3,5,4⟩+t⟨4,7,-1⟩,\,s,t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$
